EasyUse Anima 0.5.1 fixes Autocomplete suggestions that did not open in the withdrawn 0.5.0 package.

Changes:
1. Typing in supported prompt fields opens Autocomplete suggestions again.
2. Existing workflows and settings remain compatible.

Action required:
If you installed 0.5.0, update to 0.5.1 or later, restart ComfyUI, and hard-refresh the browser.
